leaves.name: fowlerProp27
leaves.doc: cm-branch, printed form: Fowler, Some uniform effective results on Andre-Oort for sums of powers in C^n, Math. Proc. Cambridge Philos. Soc. 180 (2026) 607-641, Prop. 2.7 (printed pp. 615-616, read by the upstream audit AUDIT.md item 1): for an order R of an imaginary quadratic field k with #Pic(R) <= n (n >= 1), sqrt|f^2 d_k| <= 2 n^2 exp(21000 n^2); no exceptional field. Manuscript L588-593 at n = D.

leaves.name: coxProperLattice
leaves.doc: cm-branch2, textbook leaf, consequence form: a lattice c(Z + tau Z) in C, Im tau > 0, whose multiplier ring {alpha | alpha L in L} is isomorphic to an order R of an imaginary quadratic field has tau a root of a primitive positive definite form (a, b, c'), a > 0, with b^2 - 4ac' = Delta_R = f^2 d_k. Cox, Primes of the form x^2 + ny^2 (Wiley 1989), Lemma 7.5 with Lemma 7.2 and (7.3) (numbers UNVERIFIED). Used for the manuscript's uncited L598-599 (reduced CM period), which is otherwise proved in Lean (CMBranch.reducedCMPeriod_of_leaves).
